title: Constant-ring realization preserves the canonical pro-etale exchange
statement: Let Λ be a finite commutative ring, let (g',f',f,g) be a chosen Cartesian square of schemes, and use the actual module-sheaf derived operations and ambient exchange of [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange]. For each corner T choose a ring sheaf R_T and an isomorphism e_T:Λ_T≅R_T from the associated constant ring. Give every edge h:U→V the coefficient identification H_h(R_V)≅R_U equal to H_h(e_V^{-1}) followed by the canonical constant comparison followed by e_U, using [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image]. Assume explicitly that the two composite coefficient identifications agree around the square. Let C_T:D(R_T)→D(Sh(T_proet,Mod_Λ)) be exact restriction along e_T followed by the inverse of the derived constant-ring realization from [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules, lem-weil-pbc-realized-exchange-compatibility]. Then for every K∈D(R_X), the actual ringed ambient exchange at K is invertible if and only if the source-library fixed-scalar ProEtale.derivedBaseChangeMap at C_X(K) is invertible. The assertion has no properness, boundedness, constructibility or etale-origin hypothesis.

source.note: This is the coefficient-realization normalization implicit in the first sentence of the finite-level proper-base-change proof. It is independent of the subsequent proper-base-change and etale-origin argument.

proof.text: Substitute the four assumed coefficient equalities, keeping the supplied coefficient compatibility proof. Specialize [lem-weil-pbc-realized-exchange-compatibility] to K. Its equation and the two already constructed endpoint isomorphisms give an isomorphism of arrows from C_Y prime applied to the actual ambient exchange at K to the fixed-scalar exchange at C_X(K).

The coordinates functor reflects isomorphisms: scalar restriction is conservative on module sheaves and exact, hence conservative after localization by the homology criterion; restriction to constant scalars is an exact equivalence. The isomorphism-of-arrows criterion and conservativity give both implications of the asserted IsIso equivalence.

proof_origin.note: Lean proof complete: substitute the coefficient equalities, specialize the structural compatibility, form Arrow.isoMk from the explicit source and target isomorphisms, and use isIso_iff_of_reflects_iso plus arrow_mk_iso_iff.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleRealizedExchange_isIso_iff
    {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare g' f' f g)
    (R_X : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (R_Y : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (R_X' : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X') CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (R_Y' : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y') CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (eX : etaleOriginRing X Λ ≅ R_X) (eY : etaleOriginRing Y Λ ≅ R_Y)
    (eX' : etaleOriginRing X' Λ ≅ R_X') (eY' : etaleOriginRing Y' Λ ≅ R_Y')
    (c_f : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R_Y ≅ R_X)
    (c_g : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage g CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R_Y ≅ R_Y')
    (c_g' : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage g' CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R_X ≅ R_X')
    (c_f' : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f' CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R_Y' ≅ R_X')
    (hf : c_f = proEtaleRealizedCoefficientIso Λ f eY eX)
    (hg : c_g = proEtaleRealizedCoefficientIso Λ g eY eY')
    (hg' : c_g' = proEtaleRealizedCoefficientIso Λ g' eX eX')
    (hf' : c_f' = proEtaleRealizedCoefficientIso Λ f' eY' eX')
    (hcoeff : HEq (proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients g' f R_Y R_X R_X' c_f c_g')
      (proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients f' g R_Y R_Y' R_X' c_g c_f'))
    (K : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X R_X)) :
    IsIso ((proEtaleAmbientRingedExchange sq R_X R_Y R_X' R_Y'
      c_f c_g c_g' c_f' hcoeff).app K) ↔
    IsIso ((ProEtale.derivedBaseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) sq.toCommSq).app
      ((proEtaleRealizedCoordinates Λ X R_X eX).obj K))
